notes: Paper constrains ultralight boson masses via black hole superradiance using AGN spin measurements. Three particle types analyzed: scalars (spin-0) ruled out in 2.9×10⁻²¹–1.7×10⁻¹⁷ eV, vectors (spin-1) in 6.4×10⁻²²–1.7×10⁻¹⁷ eV, tensors (spin-2) in 2.6×10⁻²³–1.7×10⁻¹⁷ eV. Paper also derives upper bounds on axion decay constant f_a (Figures 6–8) to prevent superradiance via self-interactions. The coupling_type is set to AxionMass because the primary results on decay constant vs. mass (Figures 6–8) are presented in the f_a–μ plane. However, the mass exclusion ranges (Figures 3–5) are mass-only bounds without explicit coupling values on the y-axis. Data points encode the mass ranges as horizontal lines at nominal f_a ≈ 10¹⁷ GeV (a representative scale from the figures). Extraction confidence is moderate (0.65) because: (1) the paper presents multiple coupling types (scalar, vector, tensor) and the primary exclusion plots (Figures 3–5) show only mass ranges without explicit coupling constants; (2) the decay constant bounds (Figures 6–8) are qualitative colored regions rather than tabulated numerical values; (3) the dark matter fraction constraints (Figures 9–11) mix mass and coupling information but are not the primary result.
